event_summary: A small gray rounded object moves across a tabletop from left to right behind a stationary white open container.
raw_event_description: The scene begins with a white, square-sided, open-top container standing on a light wooden tabletop. For many frames the container and table remain visually unchanged. A small gray rounded object then appears from the left side of the frame, moves rightward across the tabletop behind or partly beside the container, is briefly hidden by the container, reappears on the right side, continues rightward, and exits the visible frame. The container remains upright and visibly unchanged throughout.

reasons: The white container is fully visible near the center of the frame.
The tabletop and background are visible.
The moving gray object is not yet visible.
